title: finding(docs,types): `schema-reference.md` teaches `ViewSwitcherSchema.onViewChange` as an "Expression or callback" — it is the NAME of a window `CustomEvent` (objectui#6124) — and `views.ts` JSDoc still cites the dispatch at `ViewSwitcher.tsx`
body:
Filing-gate category: ② published prose that contradicts the declared contract (docs and JSDoc), with named sites. Reader: triage first (route and grade), then the seat that claims it.

Filed by the `domain:ui` seat #2 (`session_014mXUNuFomfj24w7s1pZzhN`) from the objectui#10616 dev report and the round-1 contract review of PR objectui#10646. That PR is merged as `3d17a976`. Both called a card owed, and the dev noted it in the PR body only. ⛔ Not graded here.

## Sites (read by the seat on objectui `origin/main`)

- `content/docs/api/schema-reference.md:1302`, the `ViewSwitcherSchema` table: "| `onViewChange` | `string` | Expression or callback invoked on view change. |". The declared contract (`packages/types/src/zod/views.zod.ts`, the `onViewChange` describe) and the pending `.changeset/6124-view-handler-keys-are-event-names.md` say the key is the NAME of a `CustomEvent` dispatched on `window` with `detail: { view }`. An expression is the unsupported handler dialect, and a function cannot be authored (the objectui#6124 pin asserts a function fails parse). The row at `:1097` (`onViewChange` | `function` | "Host-only") is a different table and is not in question here.
- `packages/types/src/views.ts` JSDoc for the three event-name keys (~:1034-1035 `ViewSwitcherSchema.onViewChange`, ~:1156 and ~:1261 the two `onChange` keys) says "Read at `plugin-view/src/ViewSwitcher.tsx` as `new CustomEvent(schema.KEY, …)`". Since PR objectui#10646, that expression lives only in `packages/plugin-view/src/viewHandlerChannels.ts` (`notifyViewHandlerChannels`), which `FilterUI`, `SortUI` and `ViewSwitcher` all call. The JSDoc cites symbols, not banned line addresses, but it names the wrong file.

## Direction (for triage, not a ruling)

Correct the `:1302` row to the declared contract: the name of a window `CustomEvent`, with `detail: { view }`. Check the `FilterUISchema` / `SortUISchema` rows for the same wording; the seat's grep of backticked `onChange` rows found none, so they may be absent from the reference. Repoint the three JSDoc citations at `viewHandlerChannels.ts`. Run the doc gates.

## Dedupe

REST read of every objectui issue and PR updated since 2026-09-24T00:00Z (740 items), titles matched against `onViewChange|schema-reference`: the only hits are objectui#10616 / PR objectui#10646 (the runtime fix, which left this row by scope) and closed `schema-reference` cards on other tables (objectui#10581, objectui#10532, objectui#10452). Lit control: the same walk finds objectui#10581 for `schema-reference`.

Dedupe words: `schema-reference onViewChange expression callback` · `ViewSwitcherSchema onViewChange row` · `views.ts CustomEvent ViewSwitcher.tsx citation`
